description: A cream canvas tote bag with dark straps sits on the bed in front, with a small pink stuffed animal off to the right. The left hand and right hand reach in and open the tote, spreading the top wide as a two-hand object while both hands rummage inside, then they release it so it stands open; afterward, the right hand lifts the pink stuffed toy and lowers it into the bag as a right-hand object.
